verdict.rationale: Loops' own docs say it offers SDKs: "add Loops to your application in minutes with our SDKs", a REST API with "typed SDKs", and an agent skill that can "install an official SDK". A published OpenAPI spec for client generation backs this up. missing for 10: which languages the SDKs cover, SDK-specific reference documentation or package details, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
